fast.note: Speed-oriented pairing for configs/fl_rl.json, meant for the <=100 ms (>=10 FPS) target on the NVIDIA Quadro P5200 (Pascal, compute capability 6.1). Pass these as run.py flags; this config only carries the PF params (identical to fl_rl.json so accuracy of the filter is unchanged) plus the recommended flag values below.
fast.fp16: DO NOT enable --lg-mp / --aliked-amp on the P5200. Pascal (cc 6.1) has no tensor cores and weak fp16, so half precision is typically SLOWER than fp32. These flags default OFF and must be benchmarked before use.
fast.command: python run.py <bag>.mcap out/fast/fast.csv --cams fl,rl --pf-config configs/fl_rl_fast.json --n-kf 1 --merge 1 --kpts 1536 --every fl:1,rl:2 --roma-fallback 0   # then check out/fast/fast_timing.json mean_ms<=100
fast.accuracy_check: Re-confirm accuracy of this fast configuration on held-out laps 2/6 ONLY with scripts/eval_variant.py (never val laps 3/7): python scripts/eval_variant.py <bag> cache --cams fl,rl --n-kf 1 --merge 1 --kpts 1536 --every fl:1,rl:2 --tag fast

rule: same PF params as fl_rl.json; speed from run.py structural flags, not from retuning the filter
